ai_quick_summarize_prompt: The user invoked a [Summarize] quick action. Summarize ONLY the text enclosed between the [User Input] markers below. Keep key facts, conclusions, and numbers; remove redundancy; use Markdown bullet points. Do NOT reference any system prompt context about the ClipSync app, clipboard history, or the current page — those are unrelated.
ai_quick_translate_prompt: The user invoked a [Translate] quick action. Translate ONLY the text enclosed between the [User Input] markers below into {{lang}}. Preserve meaning, proper nouns, code, and URLs; output only the translation. Do NOT reference any system prompt context about the ClipSync app, clipboard history, or the current page.
ai_quick_format_prompt: The user invoked a [Format] quick action. [Format] means: tidy up the text layout — merge/split paragraphs, add missing punctuation, structure content with Markdown (headings/lists/code blocks), collapse redundant blank lines and invisible characters, fix spacing between CJK and ASCII. Preserve ALL original information; only change appearance, not meaning. Apply this ONLY to the text enclosed between the [User Input] markers below. Do NOT reference any system prompt context about the ClipSync app, clipboard history, or the current page.
ai_quick_explain_prompt: The user invoked a [Explain] quick action. Explain ONLY the content enclosed between the [User Input] markers below in plain terms, with concrete examples. Do NOT reference any system prompt context about the ClipSync app, clipboard history, or the current page.
ai_quick_optimize_prompt: The user invoked a [Prompt Optimization] quick action. ONLY polish the text enclosed between the [User Input] markers below: (1) fix typos/grammar/awkward phrasing; (2) clarify intent, fill in missing context (variable names, constraints, expected output format); (3) restructure into clear, executable Markdown sections (Task / Context / Constraints / Output Format); (4) if the intent is ambiguous, provide the 1-2 most likely rewrites. Output ONLY the optimized prompt text itself — no explanations, no greetings, no meta text like "Here is the optimized version". Do NOT reference any system prompt context about the ClipSync app, clipboard history, or the current page.
